qa_pairs.question: What is RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)?
qa_pairs.ground_truth: RAG is an AI framework that combines information retrieval with text generation. It retrieves relevant documents from a knowledge base and uses them as context for a language model to generate answers.

qa_pairs.question: How does hybrid search work in RAG?
qa_pairs.ground_truth: Hybrid search combines dense vector search (semantic similarity) with sparse keyword search (BM25). Results are fused using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) to leverage both semantic and lexical matching.

qa_pairs.question: What is the purpose of reranking in RAG?
qa_pairs.ground_truth: Reranking uses a cross-encoder model to re-score retrieved candidates based on query-document relevance, improving precision by filtering out irrelevant results that passed initial vector search.
